title: Oceanic Crisp Moroccan Couscous Seffa
description: A briny, crisp one-pot Moroccan couscous dish with garlic granules and a tangy lemon finish, perfect for a vegetarian lunch.
instructions: Wash the couscous in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear.
In a medium saucepan, bring 250ml water to a rolling boil and add 1 tsp salt.
Fold the couscous into the boiling water, cover, and remove from heat; let it steam for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a small pan over medium heat and add 1 tsp garlic granules, cooking until lightly browned.
Add smoked paprika, ground cumin, and crushed red pepper flakes to the pan, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour the spice mixture over the steamed couscous, fluff with a fork, and mix until all grains are coated.
Season with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper, then fold in ¼ cup chopped cilantro and 1 tsp lemon zest.
Transfer the seffa to a serving bowl and top with 2 tbsp toasted almond slivers for a crunchy finish.
